Nina (Partnerships): Quick sync 1 QBR risk: MDF runway looks short for cloud marketplace + hardware partner co-markets. Need to rebalance by Friday. Who can pull tiered scorecards vs activation?

Arjun (Sales Ops): I can. pulling last 6 months now. will produce a compact CSV + 1-slide summary.

Nina (Partnerships): Thanks. Prioritize Silver+ partners and any with joint announcements in next 60 days.

Tom (Product): Heads-up: hardware partner EdgeGrid has a launch scheduled; they need marketplace banner + doc support. Their listing shows 0 activations.

Arjun (Sales Ops): Snippet: EdgeGrid, Bronze, MDF 7k, spent 3k, activations 0; CloudMesh, Gold, MDF 15k, spent 12k, activations 3; SIAssure, Silver, MDF 9k, spent 6k, activations 1. full sheet uploaded to drive.

Lydia (Finance): Any reallocation must be recorded in the QBR workbook for approval. Also add expected pipeline or ARR uplift assumptions.

Carmen (Comms): If we pause support for EdgeGrids launch we need a fallback comms line. Prefer neutral: "support timing to be aligned with certification checklist".

marketplace-bot: conversion dashboard refreshed: https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/stats (ref 2026-03-18 14:02 UTC)

Arjun (Sales Ops): Applying ROI filter (min 1.8x). CloudMesh and SIAssure look good. EdgeGrid fails activation threshold.

Nina (Partnerships): Proposed plan: 1) Freeze EdgeGrid marketplace MDF until activation plan submitted (due Mon). 2) Move $4k -> CloudMesh paid banner + webinar. 3) Update partner scorecards and notify GTM. 4) Carmen to draft contingency message. 5) Lydia to approve in workbook.

Lydia (Finance): I can sign off if Arjun inserts expected pipeline uplift for CloudMesh and includes confidence level. Put it in the workbook and tag me.

Arjun (Sales Ops): Added: expected uplift = $65k (3mo), confidence = medium. tagged Lydia in workbook row.

Carmen (Comms): Drafting neutral messaging now, will post in #marketing for review.

Tom (Product): I'll ask EdgeGrid for an activation timeline and tech checklist. if they can't commit, we need to postpone their announcement.

Nina (Partnerships): thumbs? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

Arjun (Sales Ops): :thumbsup:

Lydia (Finance): :thumbsup: (pending workbook entry)

Carmen (Comms): :thumbsup:

Tom (Product): :thumbsup:

Nina (Partnerships): Great. I'll log this as MDF rebalancing note for the QBR pack and pin in the partnerships folder. Scoresheets due Tue COB next week. Closing thread once Lydia confirms in the workbook.

Arjun (Sales Ops): workbook updated link: https://sheets.example.com/qbr-mdf#gid=0&range=A20

Lydia (Finance): Approved and logged. moving funds. thanks everyone.
